youtube_description:
In this video, we walked to the Button Rock Dam via the Sleepy Lion Trail. There's an option to take the road back when you get to the dam or to climb to the top of the dam to see the reservoir. We only had time to take the road, but here is a link to the proper hike that goes to the reservoir:

https://www.alltrails.com/explore/trail/us/colorado/button-rock-preserve-sleepy-lion-trail?ref=sidebar-static-map

As always, practice Leave No Trace principles when hiking! www.advenchatera.com/leave-no-trace

If you want to know what I recommend for a day hike, see here: www.advenchatera.com/day-hike-essentials

If you're worried about getting lost while hiking, get my three FREE tips:
www.advenchatera.com/dont-get-lost
